pickup.distance_method: haversine between official taxi-zone polygon area centroids, multiplied by detour_factor
pickup.interpretation: synthetic zone-level pickup cost for controlled method comparison; not measured street distance or ETA

cost_semantics.ride: direct observed training-period zone OD median proxy; not street routing
cost_semantics.financial_scoring: never changes the frozen lexicographic dispatch objective; monetary route-choice score stays blocked without required inputs and a common route candidate pool

hard_constraints: pickup and ride routes are reachable
predicted pickup wait is at most max_pickup_wait_sec
one vehicle serves at most one order per dispatch round
one order is assigned to at most one vehicle per dispatch round
existing vehicle commitments and reservation limits are preserved
method_steps: Codex CLI proposes vehicle-order assignments from the shared candidate facts, including pickup and passenger-segment EV v2 signed-net energy.
The deterministic validator rejects unknown, duplicate, unreachable, over-wait, or commitment-violating assignments.
No global mathematical optimizer is applied after the LLM response.

energy_input_contract.observed_fare_basis: NYC TLC base_passenger_fare in USD; signed values retained; historical proxy, not realized revenue
energy_input_contract.fare_usage: observed fare is recorded on the passenger service segment; partial joins remain explicitly null and never remove candidates
energy_input_contract.method_cost_scope: Codex/API usage and compute cost are recorded once per method, never apportioned to route segments
energy_input_contract.monetary_score_status: not_applied_to_assignment; any time-money route-choice score is blocked without frozen electricity tariff, method cost rates, and a common alternative-route pool

trace_fidelity.pickup_deadhead: synthetic centroid-proxy distance/time evaluated with EV v2 start-stop profile; grade unknown and treated flat
trace_fidelity.passenger_service: estimated_from direct zone OD edge conditions; grade unknown and treated flat

energy_accounting.billable_energy_basis: sum signed Link/segment energy first, then max(segment_signed_net_kwh, 0)
energy_accounting.reported_outcome: simulated net battery energy; not measured vehicle telemetry

money_accounting.passenger_fare_source: NYC TLC 2024 observed historical base passenger fare proxy; not realized revenue
missing_inputs: common alternative-route pool for time-money route choice
money_accounting.api_compute_cost_accounting: method-level usage/cost is reported once in method_costs and raw CLI traces; never duplicated in segment rows
